title.en: Goshujin-sama wa Gokigen Naname - Ikemen Koushaku to Toubou Hanayome no Amafuwa Mitsuai ♡
Kyuuseishu? Ryoushu-sama, Watashi wa Futsuu no OL desu!
Doku Oya ni Fukushuu shitai Akuyaku Reijou wa, Keiyaku Kon'yaku shita Kouri no Kikoushi ni Dekiaisareru
Ouhi ni Naru Yotei Deshita ga, Nise Seijo no Omei wo Kiserareta no de Toubou Shitara, Koutaishi ni Dekiai Saremashita. Sochira mo Douzo Oshiawase ni
Moto Dorei no Migawari Hime wa, Reiketsu Ouji no Hanayome ni Natte Dekiaisareru
Tensei Reijou wa Nigedashita Mori no Naka, Sukiro o Kushi Shite Senpuku Seikatsu o Mankitisu suru.
Kouri no Koushaku-sama to Karisome no Hanayome - Kozukuri Shitara Rikon no Hazu ga, Naze ka Chouaisaretemasu
Kokoro wo Tozashita Koushaku Kakka to Konyaku Shita Hazu na no ni, Naze ka Taisetsu ni Sasete Shimattemasu!
Hanayome Shuugyou wo Yametakute, Reitetsu Koushaku no 13-banme no Konyakusha ni narimasu
"Raise de Kekkon shite kuremasu ka" to Chikatta Buka ga, Gense de wa Toshiue no Kishi Danchou-sama ni Natte Ite, Hontou ni Kekkon wo Semararete Iru Ken
Nemurenai Kishi Danchou to no Soine wo Tanomaremashita ga, Korette Dekiai no Hajimari desu ka?
